questions.title: Keyword for Inheritance
questions.description: Which keyword establishes inheritance in Java so that a subclass acquires the fields and methods of an existing class?

questions.title: Multilevel Chain Spotter
questions.description: In multilevel inheritance, a class extends a class that itself extends another class, forming a chain. Which arrangement is multilevel inheritance?
questions.Option1: Class C extends B, and B extends A
questions.Option2: Class B and class C both directly extend A
questions.Option3: Class A extends both B and C

questions.title: Hierarchical Arrangement
questions.description: In hierarchical inheritance, one superclass serves several direct subclasses. Which of these is hierarchical inheritance?
questions.Option1: Circle, Square and Triangle all extend Shape
questions.Option2: Square extends Circle which extends Shape
questions.Option3: Shape extends Circle and Shape extends Square

questions.title: Abstract Class Truth
questions.description: Which statement about an abstract class in Java is TRUE?
questions.Option1: It can be instantiated directly with new
questions.Option2: It cannot be instantiated directly; subclasses create the objects
questions.Option4: It cannot contain fully defined concrete methods

questions.title: Interface Method Modifiers
questions.description: In a classic Java interface, a method declared without a body is implicitly given which modifiers?

questions.title: Implementing Two Interfaces
questions.description: A class can take type membership from several interfaces at once, which is Java's answer to multiple inheritance. Which class header correctly implements two interfaces?
questions.Option3: class Player implements Media extends Network

questions.title: super Keyword Meaning
questions.description: Inside a subclass, the super keyword refers to:
questions.Option2: the immediate superclass portion of the object
